nodes.label: Water-Free (Dry) Robotic Cleaning
nodes.source_file: I would love to know about ROI  and also I wonder....txt
nodes.rationale: Preferred in Egyptian deserts because manual wet cleaning needs millions of liters of demineralized water trucked in, and insufficient water bakes dust into mud; nightly dry robots keep efficiency near 99-100% (flatline vs sawtooth).

nodes.label: Cleaning-Robot ROI and Payback (1.5-4 Years)
nodes.source_file: I would love to know about ROI  and also I wonder....txt
nodes.rationale: Nightly robotic cleaning yields 3-5% more annual energy than periodic manual cleaning and cuts OPEX 40-50% by removing crews, trucks, and desert water logistics.

nodes.label: Dry-Cleaning Abrasion Risk (Sandpaper Effect on Anti-Reflective Coating)
nodes.source_file: I would love to know about ROI  and also I wonder....txt
nodes.rationale: Brushing dry sand across glass can scratch the ARC over 20 years; mitigated by very soft microfibers certified by panel manufacturers; water acts as a lubricant flushing abrasive particles.
